events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music. What's your favourite iconic Woodstock moment?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977; he would have been 91 years old.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legacy live on.

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996; he would have been 55 years old.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. His impact on music and culture is undeniable.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, passed away on September 18, 1970; he would have been 83 years old.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 83 this year. His guitar mastery changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on September 26, 1969, featuring classic tracks and that famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: The Fab Four crossed that iconic road and delivered a masterpiece. What's your top track from The Beatles' 'Abbey Road'?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today, born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the legendary Chrissie Hynde, turning 75 today! Her distinctive voice and songwriting continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today, born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher turns 54 today! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon Released Imagine
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates today. What does it mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you held one of these? 25 years since the original iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! Happy James Bond Day to all the 007 fans out there. Who's your favourite Bond and what's your top theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940; he would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy.

events.title: The Beatles Release The White Album
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: An epic double album that pushed boundaries. What are your hidden gems from The Beatles' 'White Album'?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991; he would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
